brief: Prioritise pre-event attention for this ageing unit to address its reduced margin against mechanical failure and accumulated heat exposure, as outlined in MG-023. If the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, per MG-023. Additionally, where a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity to maintain unobstructed airflow to the radiator banks and ventilation openings, as specified in SOP-011.
